173491.overview: Galaxians is a fixed screen shoot 'em up, most similar to Galaxian. Lately a number of freighters have gone missing and scans show that alien ships are present in the area. Now it's up to the player to seek out and take out these subversive life forms. Like in the original arcade game, the player controls his ship left or right at the bottom of the screen and shoots toward the aliens above him. The aliens start in stationary positions, but at times they swoop down towards the player and attacks. The player gets points for each killed alien. The amount of points awarded is based on how close to the player they are. After a wave of aliens has been killed, the player moves on to the next level and the difficulty increases.

175623.overview: Green Cross Toad (also called Green X Toad) is a clone of the popular arcade game Frogger. It was published by IJK on December 10, 1984.

175846.overview: Ghostman is a Pacman clone for the Oric computer. As in the famous Namco game, you steer a ball with a mouth around a maze patrolled by four ghosts. Notable differences in this interpretation is that all the ghosts are the same colour (the same colour as Ghostman and the dots, probably to avoid problems with attribute clash) – and presumably moving by the same logic – and that the maze's "tunnel" goes between the top and bottom of the screen instead of left to right.

183929.overview: Galaxion is a fixed screen shoot 'em up. The game is as can be expected inspired by the arcade game Galaxian but here invaders only descends toward the player after they have been shot. Before that the invaders only move back and forth in a formation of six rows. The player can get killed by colliding with a descending alien or by getting hit by a projectile. The game ends when all three lives are lost. When all enemies have been killed the game moves on to a new level which plays in the same way. Before starting out it is possible to choose the speed of the attackers as well as the density of their missiles.

440171.overview:
The treasure of Emperor Reagassus is hidden in a secret maze. Your task is to enter this maze and collect as much treasure as possible. You must avoid the Demon skulls and cunning creatures which inhabit the maze. To help you in your task you have been supplied with a magic spray - use this with care to stop the creatures.

Take care not to use it too much!

How Long Can You Survive The Maze?

Another top quality machine code arcade game from IJK. Features scrolling maze, animated creatures, different levels, screens etc. etc. Operated by keyboard or joystick (With Oric/IJK Interface).

440172.overview:
An exciting new compendium of 5 all arcade action games from Durell Software. 

GALAXY, ASTRO-WAR, SPACECHASE - 3 games in pure machine code. 

LUNAR LANDER, ASTEROIDS - 2 games in BASIC, including autolist at end of play with line-by-line program explanation.
